input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text, /moves/queen_d8.text, or /moves/bishop_c8.text must be signed by that piece and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, matching the stricter thresholds already applied to pawn_a7 and knight_b8, since those pieces have also gone off plan through greed or amnesia.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_f8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
